title: 第十九章 对鸪图二姐妹安排第二十章 出发前的一些事
content_zh:
颜铁龙以防万一陆续使用轻步隐身这个技能，逐一将挟持鸪图二姐妹的不明份子同伙打晕。
颜铁龙最后将挟持二名鸪图二姐妹的不明份子击晕，鸪图二姐妹的大姐看到解救自己的救命恩人吃惊道：“是，是你！”。
“哥哥，你是来救我们来的吧！”鸪图莉雪看到刚刚挟持她们的坏人倒在地上以及突然出现颜铁龙十分高兴问道。
“恩，对了，小雪你感冒这么样了？”颜铁龙关心鸪图莉雪感冒这么样了，就问道。
鸪图莉雪听到颜铁龙关心的询问就转了转身体高兴道：“大哥哥，我的早上就不咳嗽，而且感觉身体轻松不少了，我想我的感冒应该好了吧。”。
“小雪不是你觉得感冒好了就好了，哥哥要检查一下，要是还没有好那就糟糕了。”颜铁龙听到鸪图莉雪说自己的感冒已经好了，颜铁龙不放心道。
“你要干什么？”鸪图莉琦看到颜铁龙要靠近她妹妹，他急忙拦在颜铁龙面前问道。
“我只是查看你妹妹的体温以及她的喉咙情况，来判定你妹妹的病是否好了，你拦着我这位鼎鼎大名的药剂师这种行为对你妹妹真的好吗？”颜铁龙看到眼前护着妹妹的鸪图莉琦问道。
“姐姐，大哥哥不是你请来给我看病的吗？”鸪图莉雪看到姐姐保护她的样子，就疑惑的问道。
鸪图莉琦听到妹妹的话并没有回答她，反而一脸严肃看到颜铁龙威胁道：“你给我妹妹看病可以，但是你做其他事，我一定不会放过你。”。
“放心好啦，我只看病，绝对不干其他事情。”颜铁龙看着眼前鸪图莉琦回应道，同时他内心想道：“这个叫鸪图莉琦心里还真是阴暗啊！”。
颜铁龙用手感受鸪图莉雪额头的温度，然后查看了鸪图莉雪喉咙没有发炎情况，自己小声嘀咕：“看来四分之一的特效药，对儿童的量刚刚好吗！”。
身为鸪图莉雪姐姐的小乞丐，她看到自己妹妹对让自己讨厌的家伙那么亲密，就将自己妹妹拉到一边问道：“妹妹你怎么管他叫哥哥呢？”。
鸪图莉雪听到姐姐的话一副理所当然的回答道：“姐姐，大哥哥喜欢别人叫他大哥哥，所以我就叫他哥哥哦！”。
“这个混蛋！！”小乞丐听到自己妹妹的话，就暗骂了一句。
“姐姐，这么了，难道有什么不对吗？”鸪图莉雪看到自己姐姐厌恶的样子问道。
“没，没事。”小乞丐听到自己妹妹疑惑询问自己就摇摇头道。
“这，这位，大，大哥哥，请你能跟我来一下好吗？”小乞丐来到颜铁龙面前有点难为情的样子喊颜铁龙大哥哥，并让他跟自己来一趟。
“小姑娘，我全名叫颜铁龙，我只是看你妹妹比较顺眼所以让你妹妹叫铁龙哥哥，至于你要是不习惯叫大哥哥的话，可以叫我名字。！”颜铁龙自我介绍道并对小乞丐提醒道。
“你！你到底要不要跟我来？还有我不叫小姑娘，我有名字，我叫鸪图莉琦！”鸪图莉琦听到颜铁龙叫她小乞丐就鼓起脸颊生气的自我介绍并问道。

“ok，那你带路吧。”颜铁龙对生气的鸪图莉琦要带他去什么地方，十分好奇就同意道。
颜铁龙不管欧斯派恩还以防守方式对付活力十足年轻人，跟着鸪图莉琦走向街道胡同与此同时鸪图莉雪看着自己姐姐有些奇怪样子，也悄悄跟了上去。
颜铁龙跟鸪图莉琦来到死胡同里就说道：“好了，这里没有什么人？小，鸪图莉琦小姐你可以说出你让我跟你来这里有什么事了？”。
鸪图莉琦围着颜铁龙走了一圈，神情戒备看着颜铁龙说道：“你，你到底是什么人？为什么要接近我们？”。
“小姑娘，你以为你是谁啊！我有必要刻意接近你们吗？你要是说这些无聊的事的话，恕我不奉陪。”颜铁龙听到鸪图莉琦戒备的询问自己为什么跟踪她，颜铁龙语气不屑说完就要转身要走。
“等等！”鸪图莉琦快速拉住颜铁龙去路道。
“鸪图莉琦小姐，我的耐心是有限的，你还有什么事？”颜铁龙看着拉住自己的鸪图莉琦问道。
“刚，刚刚是我不对，还，还有谢谢您救了我妹妹！”鸪图莉琦神情变的有点扭捏对颜铁龙道歉和道谢，然后低着头等待大人审判的样子。
content_en:
Yan Tielong used the skill of light step invisibility one after another just in case, and knocked out the unknown accomplices who held the two sisters hostage one by one.
Yan Tielong finally knocked out the unknown person who held the two sisters hostage. The eldest sister of the two sisters was surprised when she saw her savior: "Yes, it's you!".
"Brother, you are here to save us, right!" Qitu Lixue asked happily when she saw the bad guy who had just held them hostage fall to the ground and Yan Tielong suddenly appeared.
"Well, by the way, Xiaoxue, you have a cold like this?" Yan Tielong asked, concerned about the fact that Tu Lixue had a cold.
After hearing Yan Tielong's concerned inquiry, Yutu Lixue turned around and said happily: "Brother, I don't cough this morning, and I feel a lot more relaxed. I think my cold should be gone.".
"Xiaoxue, you just think the cold is gone. Brother, I need to check it out. If it's not gone yet, that's bad." Yan Tielong said worriedly when he heard Qitu Lixue say that his cold was gone.
"What are you going to do?" When Zituliqi saw Yan Tielong approaching her sister, he hurriedly stopped in front of Yan Tielong and asked.
"I'm just checking your sister's temperature and the condition of her throat to determine whether your sister's illness is cured. Is it really good for your sister that you're stopping me, a famous pharmacist?" Yan Tielong asked when he saw Zituliqi protecting his sister in front of him.
"Sister, didn't you invite me to see a doctor?" Lutulixue asked doubtfully when she saw her sister protecting her.
When Zituliqi heard her sister's words, she did not answer her. Instead, with a serious look on her face, Yan Tielong threatened: "You can treat my sister, but if you do other things, I will not let you go."
"Don't worry, I only see patients and will never do anything else." Yan Tielong responded while looking at Qituli Qi in front of him, and at the same time he thought in his heart: "This Qiao Tuliqi is really dark in her heart!".
Yan Tielong felt the temperature of Lvtulixue's forehead with his hand, then checked that Lvtulixue's throat was not inflamed. He whispered to himself: "It seems that a quarter of the special medicine is just the right amount for children!"
As the little beggar of Li Xue's sister, she saw that her sister was so close to the guy she hated, so she pulled her sister aside and asked: "Sister, why do you call him brother?".
After hearing her sister's words, Ritu Lixue replied matter-of-factly: "Sister, the eldest brother likes others to call him eldest brother, so I will call him brother!".
"This bastard!!" The little beggar cursed secretly when he heard his sister's words.
"Sister, is there anything wrong with this?" Qitu Lixue asked when she saw her sister's disgusted look.
"No, it's okay." The little beggar shook his head when he heard his sister asking him doubts.
"This, this, eldest, eldest brother, can you please come with me?" The little beggar came to Yan Tielong and looked a little embarrassed and called eldest brother Yan Tielong, and asked him to come with him.
"Little girl, my full name is Yan Tielong. I just think your sister is more pleasing to the eye, so I asked your sister to call her Brother Tielong. If you are not used to calling me brother, you can call me by my name!" Yan Tielong introduced himself and reminded the little beggar.
"You! Do you want to come with me? And I'm not called little girl. I have a name. My name is Qi Tuliqi!" When Qiu Tuliqi heard Yan Tielong call her a little beggar, she puffed up her cheeks and introduced herself angrily and asked.
"Okay, then you can lead the way." Yan Tielong agreed as he was very curious about where the angry Qituliqi wanted to take him.
Yan Tielong ignored Ospine and used a defensive approach to deal with the energetic young man, and followed Yutu Liqi to the streets and alleys. At the same time, Yutu Lixue saw that his sister looked strange, and followed quietly.
Picture of Yan Tielong and QianLiqi came to the dead end and said: "Okay, there is no one here? Xiao, Miss Liqi, can you tell me why you asked me to come here with you?".
Zituliqi walked around Yan Tielong, looked at Yan Tielong with a wary expression and said, "You, who are you? Why do you want to approach us?".
"Little girl, who do you think you are! Do I need to deliberately approach you? If you say these boring things, please forgive me for not accompanying you." Yan Tielong heard Qituli Qi's wary question about why he was following her. Yan Tielong said in a disdainful tone and turned to leave.
"Wait!" Zituli Qi quickly pulled Yan Tielong to the road.
"Miss Zituliqi, my patience is limited. What else can you do?" Yan Tielong asked, looking at Zituliqi who was holding him.
"Just now, it was my fault just now. Also, thank you for saving my sister!" Zituliqi's expression became a little awkward as she apologized and thanked Yan Tielong, then lowered her head and waited for the Lord's trial.
